content.title: How to Tune In to the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards—Even Without Cable (Yes, Taylor Swift Will Be There)
content.text: The 13th annual iHeartRadio Music Awards are officially here! Celebrating the most-played artists of 2025 and giving us a first look at the hits of 2026, this year’s ceremony at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles promises to be one of the biggest nights in music.So whether you're tuning in to see Taylor Swift make her first awards show in-person appearance of the year or to catch the historic reunion of TLC, Salt-N-Pepa and En Vogue, here is everything you need to know about how to watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards.🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 When are the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards?The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards are Thursday, March 26, 2026 at 8:00 p.m. ET. For those on the West Coast, the broadcast is typically tape-delayed to air at 8:00 p.m. PT.What channel are the iHeartRadio Music Awards on?You can watch the full ceremony live on FOX. If you have a digital antenna or a cable/satellite subscription, just tune into your local FOX affiliate.How to stream the 2026 iHeartRadio Music AwardsThe show will be available to stream through many platforms, including:Live TV Streaming: Services like Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, FuboTV and Sling TV (in select markets) carry FOX.iHeartRadio App: You can listen to the broadcast for free on iHeartRadio stations nationwide and via the iHeartRadio app. (Note that this is an audio feed only.)FOX.com: You can often stream live via the FOX website or app by logging in with your TV provider credentials.What is Taylor Swift going to do at the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards?While she isn’t officially on the performer list, Taylor is confirmed to make a special in-person appearance at the Dolby Theatre. The iHeartRadio Music Awards will mark her very first awards show appearance of 2026.Taylor is the most-nominated artist of the night with nine nods, mostly for her record-breaking track "The Fate of Ophelia" and her Eras Tour concert film. Fans are speculating that because it is the 13th year of the iHeart Awards—Taylor’s lucky number—she might have a major surprise or announcement up her sleeve.Will Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift walk the iHeart Radio Awards 2026 red carpet together?Unfortunately, we do not know that yet. But we sure hope so!Fun Facts: Taylor’s iHeart History by the NumbersTaylor is the most-awarded artist in iHeartRadio Music Awards history with 34 wins to date.At the 2025 ceremony, she was honored with the first-ever "Tour of the Century" award for The Eras Tour.Her appearance this year is perfectly timed for the 13th anniversary of the show.She leads the 2026 nominees with 9 nominations—including Artist of the Year and Song of the Year.Related: ‘Mastermind’ Indeed! Taylor Swift’s Net Worth in 2026 and How She Achieved Billionaire StatusWho is hosting the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards?Rapper and actor Ludacris will both host and be honored at the ceremony.Photo by Prince Williams on Getty Images (Photo by Prince Williams on Getty Images)Grammy-winner Ludacris returns as the host this year and will also be honored with the 2026 iHeartRadio Landmark Award.Who is performing at the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards?Alex Warren — Breakthrough Artist of the Year recipientRAYEKehlaniJohn Mellencamp — Icon Award recipientTLC, Salt-N-Pepa, and En Vogue — Performing together for the first time!Related: 90s Icons Just Announced a Massive Summer Tour — And Fans Are Losing ItSpecial Honors at the 2026 iHeartRadio Music AwardsMiley Cyrus will be honored at the iHeartRadio Music Awards.Photo by Michael Buckner on Getty Images (Photo by Michael Buckner on Getty Images)Miley Cyrus: Receiving the iHeartRadio Innovator Award.John Mellencamp: Receiving the iHeartRadio Icon Award.Ludacris: Receiving the iHeartRadio Landmark Award (and hosting!).Alex Warren: Receiving the Breakthrough Artist of the Year Award.Select 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards NomineesWhile Taylor Swift leads the nominations, she’s in good company with artists like Sabrina Carpenter, Bad Bunny and Alex Warren. They all have eight nominations a piece.Song of the Year"The Fate of Ophelia" — Taylor Swift"Manchild" — Sabrina Carpenter"Anxiety" — Doechii"Ordinary" — Alex Warren"Good News" — Shaboozey"Stargazing" — Myles Smith"Mutt" — Leon Thomas"Sorry I'm Here For Someone Else" — Benson BooneArtist of the YearTaylor SwiftSabrina CarpenterKendrick LamarBad BunnyBenson BooneMorgan WallenPop Artist of the YearTaylor SwiftSabrina CarpenterTate McRaeBenson BooneAlex WarrenFan-Voted Categories — The "Social" AwardsFavorite K-Pop Collab: "On My Mind" (Alex Warren & ROSÉ), "BORN AGAIN" (LISA ft. Doja Cat & RAYE).Favorite TikTok Dance: Includes "The Fate of Ophelia" (Taylor Swift), "Abracadabra" (Lady Gaga), and "JUMP" (BLACKPINK).Best Lyrics: "Manchild" (Sabrina Carpenter), "Camera" (Ed Sheeran), "Ordinary" (Alex Warren).Best Music Video: "The Fate of Ophelia" (Taylor Swift), "toxic till the end" (ROSÉ), "Sapphire" (Ed Sheeran).Favorite Debut Album: Alex Warren (You'll Be Alright, Kid), JENNIE (Ruby), LISA (Alter Ego).Next, How To Watch the 2026 ACM Awards for Free on May 17—Plus Performers, Nominees and Start TimeThis story was originally published by Parade on Mar 25, 2026, where it first appeared in the TV section.
